deviations:
1) S5/Loop path: as written, SVG L1's path returns exactly to its start point (416.7,40.5) and then continues. The SVG importer welds that into a single vertex with three connections, and Figma refused PATH_TRIM_END ("not supported on ... closed or complex vector networks"). I re-imported L1 with the start point moved 0.5 px along its own tangent, to M417.2 40.465. The rest of the path is unchanged, and the curve looks the same with the same bounds. The first import (wrapper 42:15307, my own) was deleted. The new wrapper is S5/Loop 42:16198 (twin 42:16200) at (110,391), and the vector is S5/Loop path 42:16199 (twin 42:16201). All 4 Loop tracks were accepted on it.
2) Resting state: setting a track makes Figma write that track's t=0 value into the node's base property. As a result, S5 · Offer + CTA, S5/Ripple, S5/Loop path, S5/Arrow shaft and S5/Arrow head now rest at opacity 0, and S5/Field rests at 1080x1920, radius 0, still positioned at (220,1100). This contradicts spec 3.4 (resting opacity 1). It cannot be fixed: I tested on a throwaway probe rect (created and then deleted, my own) and figma_set_opacity 1 leaves the opacity at 0 and the keys unchanged. I did the static layout checks before keyframing, so a figma_export_node of the container now renders empty.
3) Cormorant Garamond SemiBold renders old-style figures, so in "10%" the "1" and "0" sit at x-height. Their tops are at screen y ~586 instead of ~495; the baseline is ~750 and the % top ~516. I kept them as build note 3 allows; the loop still encloses them.
4) Per spec 3.6, I bound the static paints to variables: Field fill and Ripple stroke to color/accent/default; the 7 cream texts and the Loop stroke to color/bg/page; the CTA label and both arrow strokes to color/text/inverse. Nothing in S5 has keyframed paints.
5) Measured widths and the positions that follow from them: Ten/1 133, Ten/0 191, Ten/% 230, so masks 185/243/282 (the row centres them at local x 173/306/497). off 184, so off-mask 232x240 at (424,800). your/first/order. 160/137/195, so masks 208/185/243 at x 182/366/527 inside S5/Line. CTA label 374 wide, so it sits at (103,36) and S5/Arrow at (497,46).
